title: Add Regexly to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Regexly](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/regexly) to build
- Describe a regex pattern in plain English, get the regular expression with flavor-specific explanation (JavaScript/Python/PCRE). BYOP Pollinations-powered.

Fixes #14987

gist.headline: Plain English, Sharp Regex
gist.blurb: Regexly joined the garden: describe the pattern you mean, and it grows into a regex with an explanation for its chosen habitat. JavaScript, Python, and PCRE can now stop pretending they all speak the same dialect.
gist.summary: Added the Pollinations-powered Regexly app to the build, letting people describe a regex in plain English and receive a generated pattern plus flavor-specific explanations for JavaScript, Python, or PCRE.
gist.impact: Users can turn an intent such as a validation or text-matching rule into a usable regex and understand how it maps to their selected JavaScript, Python, or PCRE flavor.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Regexly as a cozy garden-workbench where plain-English notes transform into curling, neatly labeled regex vines for JavaScript, Python, and PCRE. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, tends the code-plants while a friendly CRT robot reads the resulting pattern; a retro terminal and small flowers make the translation from words to syntax feel approachable.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden-workbench where handwritten plain-English notes bloom into tidy curly regex vines labeled "JS", "PY", and "PCRE" beside a lime green (#ecf874) retro terminal; Polli, a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wears tiny librarian glasses and carefully prunes a code-plant while a chunky CRT-monitor robot holds a regex printout. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with warm cream, mint, lavender, and peach accents, subtle CRT glow, pixel flowers, and simple pixel-font text: "WORDS → REGEX"; nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
